notes.tailwind_boundary: Tailwind utilities are allowed for structure and token-backed semantics, but raw palette hues, named colors, and arbitrary color literals are forbidden.
notes.global_vs_feature_css: Global UI lives in ui/styles (layers reset/tokens/contract). Feature CSS must stay in @layer feature and must not define visual tokens.
notes.change_policy: Theme changes are token-only. Contract expansion requires RFC + approval.
notes.spec_version_notes: B1 Tailwind boundary; data-ui contract; themes are token-only. Phase 1 complete: navy+orange SSOT, data-theme protocol, scripts/ui/* modular.
